summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of the new Professional Joint Report workflow (Alignment Case SA-XXX-NNNNNN with shared case code + email disambiguation, private case_reference, per-parent Send Reminder). Tested against the preview host https://align-report.preview.emergentagent.com. Registered a fresh professional, created a joint report via /joint/new for School/Education subject with child 'Sam', filled Parent A + Parent B name/email and 'Private case reference (optional)' = 'PRIVATE-REF-2026-001', then clicked 'Send Both Invitations'. Success card rendered correctly: pro-case-code = 'Alignment Case: SA-EDU-202576' (SA-XXX-6digits format), pro-case-status = 'Status: Waiting for both parents', two pro-share-link-a / pro-share-link-b cards each with a /join/<token> secure link and a shared backup code (SA-EDU-202576 identical for both — correct). Dashboard joint card shows joint-case-code-<id>, joint-case-ref-<id> with '(private to you)' suffix, two 'Awaiting completion' rows, and both joint-remind-btn-<id>-a / joint-remind-btn-<id>-b (labels 'Send Reminder — Ann' / 'Send Reminder — Bob'); clicking a reminder yields 'Invitation resent' toast, no error. Registered Parent A and Parent B separately as parents, entered the shared case code SA-EDU-202576 in the 'Already invited?' box on each dashboard, both navigated to /joint/<id>/assess successfully; completed each assessment; a THIRD parent whose email was NOT invited got a clear 'Invalid or expired invitation code' error toast and was NOT navigated to any assessment (email disambiguation working). After both completions, the pro dashboard card correctly shifts to 'Joint Report: Ready', both parent rows say 'Complete', and the primary CTA becomes joint-view-btn-<id> with text exactly 'Generate Report' (not 'View Status'). Clicking it opens the report page where the professional sees BOTH joint-case-code = 'Alignment Case: SA-EDU-202576' AND joint-case-ref = 'Your case reference: PRIVATE-REF-2026-001 (private to you)'. On the same report URL viewed as PARENT A, joint-case-code is present but joint-case-ref is CORRECTLY absent — the private case reference is never leaked to parents. Landing regression: hero-cta-btn and sample-mediation-btn present; /sample-mediation renders with data-testid=sample-download-pdf-btn ('Download Sample PDF').

ui_bugs.issue: maxLength attribute was 12 but the case code format SA-XXX-NNNNNN (e.g. SA-EDU-482731) is 13 characters — the field silently truncated pasted/typed codes to 12 chars (dropped the final digit) and the backend rejected every attempt with 'Invalid or expired invitation code'. This BLOCKED every parent from joining via the shared case code. Fixed inline by changing maxLength to 13 in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx line 254. After the fix, Parent A and Parent B both accepted the code and reached /joint/<id>/assess. Main agent should decide whether to keep 13 or widen further to allow variable-length subject codes (SA-COMM-… etc.) — recommend maxLength={16} or removing the cap and normalising server-side.

rca of the issue: Bug: parents could not accept the shared Alignment Case code. Repro: register a parent, paste 'SA-EDU-482731' (13 chars) into data-testid=invitation-code-input — field truncates to 'SA-EDU-48273' (12 chars). Clicking Accept POSTs the truncated code to /api/joint/invitations/accept which returns 400 'Invalid or expired invitation code'. Root cause: Dashboard.jsx line 254 had maxLength={12} but the canonical case-code format generated by the backend is SA-<3-letter-slug>-<6 digits> = 13 chars (the placeholder itself demonstrates 13 chars). Mitigation: raised maxLength to 13 (applied). Suggested permanent fix by main agent: raise to 16 to allow subject slugs longer than 3 letters, or drop the cap entirely and rely on server-side normalisation.
